findings.text: follow-on: test_a_moved_plan_file_is_not_served_stale rewrites probe.html in place and asserts estimated_hours becomes 7.0, but the hours are re-read from that same plan_path by _section_effort_hours (picker/__init__.py:66) on every pick, so the assertion passes whether or not the cache stamp moved; the case a stale cached resolution would actually break -- a plan renamed to a different path -- is not exercised, so the stamp-invalidation path is unguarded.

follow-on: the item-2 cut figure (capability_ms 1497.17 with the per-pick read restored against 1083.96 with the cut, one pick per process) appears only in this manifest; profile_capability.py's own output is not captured to any log under the run directory, so the headline measurement has no receipt a reader can open, and it is produced by a different instrument than the done-when named.

follow-on: neither gate_head.log nor gate_base.log opens with a line naming the revision it ran at, the tree and the command, so the 194-passed EXIT=0 and 190-passed EXIT=0 summaries do not tie to reviewed heads 4821665f and 42531caaf by the logs alone.

follow-on: the driver selects the ten slowest picks (slowest_count 10) but silently drops any case whose ledger row does not match (row is None), so only nine are replayed; the manifest and the driver docstring both say the ten slowest, and the dropped pick is nowhere recorded.

follow-on: stamp_of reaches across modules for the private ledger._file_identity as the resolved-path stamp, coupling the picker to a ledger internal when capabilities.file_stamp is the picker-visible stamp helper already imported in this function.

justifications.durability: test_the_cut_stops_the_repeated_docs_scan (tests/test_pick_stages_fit_the_bound.py:195) counts resources.resolve_resource calls and is shown red for the restored read by negative_control.log (EXIT=1), and test_the_removed_read_is_what_the_cut_eliminated (:217) proves the restored path pays the scan, but test_a_moved_plan_file_is_not_served_stale (:237) edits the plan in place and the hours are re-read from that same path by _section_effort_hours (picker/__init__.py:66), so it passes even if the file stamp never moves and does not guard the stale-path case its name claims.
justifications.evidence: gate_base.log 190 passed EXIT=0 and gate_head.log 194 passed EXIT=0 give zero added failures, and the negative control reddens test_the_cut_stops_the_repeated_docs_scan, an id the head arm does not fail; the replay's recorded medians (1805.0/5882.9/7146.0) and warm medians (19.0/10.2/33.3) reconcile exactly with replay_head_iso.json. But neither gate log carries a header naming the revision, tree and command, so its pass counts do not tie to 42531caaf/4821665f; the headline cut figure has no log receipt; the done-when's named before/after replay cannot show the cut (it is masked in one process); and one of the ten slowest picks is silently dropped.
justifications.fit: The additions follow the module's docstring-and-helper idiom (picker/__init__.py:85, 134) and reuse the existing noqa convention; names (_resolved_plan_path, cached_pick_input_stamped) describe the mechanism and carry no plan, sprint or ticket label, and every exception is justified in a comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node's done-when was one-typesafe-model-picker s12 items 1-2: attribute the tail per stage and cut what is code. The manifest attributes snapshot_ms, state_render_ms and capability_ms to load (recorded medians 1805.0/7146.0/5882.9 ms against replayed warm medians 33.0/19.0/10.2 ms) and cuts one per-pick docs-tree resolve at picker/__init__.py:85, but the done-when's named instrument -- the replay driver run before and after showing a lower median for the cut stage -- is not satisfied: the manifest states the in-process replay masks the cut and substitutes a one-pick-per-process figure reported only in the manifest. The cohort is nine picks, not the stated ten.
justifications.reuse: The cut routes through the existing capabilities.cached_pick_input_stamped rather than forking a cache, and reuses capabilities.file_stamp and routing._docs_scan_directories, but it reaches across modules for the private ledger._file_identity as a stamp helper (picker/__init__.py:121), and _declared_difficulty keeps a duplicate resolve_resource fallback beside the cached call.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff of 42531caaf..4821665f touches only reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py, tests/test_pick_stages_fit_the_bound.py and docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/pick-stages-fit-the-bound.html, all inside the node's declared write paths; the reviewed worktree is clean and no plan or project index file is modified.
